‘Dollar Has No Bottom’
In a Fox News interview, Pompliano said Bitcoin does not depend on the
, but is shaped more by global liquidity and fiat money printing.
He further emphasized the U.S.’s burgeoning national debt, currently over $40 trillion, and argued that Bitcoin’s value has no ceiling as long as the dollar continues to devalue.
“Bitcoin has no top because the dollar has no bottom,” Pompliano reiterated.
Debasement Trade Is Back?

CoinGlass data largely backs Pompliano’s view that Bitcoin tends to benefit from a growing global money supply. But that link has weakened in the 2025-2026 bear market, with Bitcoin prices falling despite rising liquidity.
“If the government keeps printing money, Bitcoin is going to go way higher in the coming years,” Pompliano projected.

Bitcoin Takes Off
Pompliano said last month that people in Washington, D.C., are “absolutely ridiculous,” and he’s willing to bet on their "stupidity" to print more money.
He maintains that Bitcoin will eventually reach $1 million due to this play.

Bitcoin reached an intraday high of $87,363 on Monday, its highest since late January, as the SEC’s push to build a regulatory framework for cryptocurrency, including tokenized U.S. stocks, outweighed the CLARITY Act’s failure.
Price Action
: At the time of writing, BTC was exchanging hands at $85,736, up 5.13% in the last 24 hours, according to data from Benzinga Pro.
ProCap Shares rose 1.47% in after-hours trading. The stock closed 8.24% higher at $4.07 during Monday’s regular trading session.
